assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. High-fidelity Chinese app UI for 同拍 ONEBEAT. Incremental design based on existing app, not a wireframe, not a marketing illustration. Crisp Chinese type, black ink outlines, coral #FF7056, lilac #C5B7EB, warm ivory paper #FFF9EE, pure white controls. User-approved outer radius 8vp, inner radius 6vp. ALL shadows must be opaque black offset slabs, +4vp x/y, blur ZERO, no gray ambient glow or feathered gradient. Do not add any new mascot, logo or video artwork. Style summaries everywhere display at most TWO unique style names, then literal "…" if more than two, following first appearance order. No third style name in a summary. Shared graphic language from the refined drum page reference.

Asset: a focused presentation of the TEAM LOBBY active PRO drum arrangement EDIT card. Reference image is the accepted drum editor VISUAL SYSTEM ONLY, do not copy its whole-page content. Draw a new card matching the actual lobby structure described below, not a whole unrelated lobby redesign.
Composition: one polished portrait design sheet, approximately1024x1400, with large title "队伍大厅 · 鼓机编排卡片". Upper two thirds show a LARGE realistic single active card on the page, readable UI without phone hardware; lower area shows two smaller style-summary examples. Small tasteful coral and lilac fading halftones only at sheet margins.
Main active card background pale lilac #EDE6FF, black2vp outline, R8, SOLID black lower-right shadow blur0. Inner padding14vp. Header row: italic heavy "PRO 定制鼓机" left, small pale blue tilted "已应用" stamp right. Under header retain small "月卡已解锁" status.
Middle information row: LEFT a small white square icon tile R6 with a clean black arrangement glyph made from three horizontal short bars, suggesting a sequence; do not use a single style's large colored circle. RIGHT, small gray contextual heading "本编排", then prominent BORDERLESS style chips: coral "摇滚", yellow "爵士", followed by "…". Exactly two style names, not 放克. No single-style poetic caption like 硬朗推进, because this program has three styles.
Under style chips, retain compact editable meter "4/4 ⌄" and BPM numeric "120" with BPM label. These are real lobby settings, not per-style tempos. Use pure white fields with black outline R6. Arrange cleanly, keep readable, no plus/minus controls added to this compact card.
Next metadata row: two small cream chips "3个段落" and "12小节循环", thin ink outlines and crisp hard shadows.
Bottom actions: familiar lilac button "编辑鼓机" on left; white button "切回节拍打点" on right, both full readable text, R6, black outline and hard offset shadow. Keep this exact second button label; no switch/delete/record actions.
Outside the main card, below a subtle divider, two small comparison examples demonstrating ONLY the style summary area: label "单风格" with one coral 摇滚 chip and NO ellipsis; label "两种风格" with coral 摇滚 plus yellow 爵士 and NO ellipsis. The main card above is the example of 3+styles and has the ellipsis. Small external note at bottom "最多展示两种风格，更多用 …".
No giant arrangement-name feature or fabricated saved name, no shopping activity, no album artwork. The design changes only active drum card summary and its icon, while preserving its actual existing controls and status. Crisp small radii and genuinely hard ink shadows.

Asset: full walking/marching page with the EXISTING bottom control panel's style drawer redesigned as ARRANGEMENT SWITCHER. Reference1 is actual current app screenshot: preserve its warm seaside stage composition and existing illustrated purple-haired character exactly, and native-style top and bottom panels. Reference2 provides the newly approved hard-shadow UI, radii, and concise saved arrangement cards. This is a polished design proposal based on current app, NOT an unrelated rhythm sequencer.
Canvas: one portrait full app screen with small external design-sheet caption "行进页 · 编排切换". Around1024x1792 or taller. No collage, no angled phone. Top panel and stage remain visible. This mock depicts NOT RECORDING; remove old recording-only mic waveform, live-activity black capsule in system status bar, and stage stop-recording pill from screenshot reference so the new drawer is the focus. Keep existing coral sky, teal sea, yellow ground, and original character identity unchanged, do not redesign character.
Top app panel: "一起行进" with small LIVE tag, green "队长时钟", gear icon; large coral120 BPM, 4/4, and four beat blocks, white backdrop with black bottom border. Familiar actual app layout.
Bottom panel: white, five controls in SAME order and position: LEFT square38vp icon button now an arrangement glyph (three horizontal bars), label below "编排" (not 风格 and never the character 风); then – button; large coral circular PLAY button; + button; far-right round red recording-dot button with small "录制" label. Keep bottom text "点击播放 · 全队一起出发", NOT currently playing. Do not change button locations or introduce another panel row.
EXTENDING STRIP: directly above this bottom row, within the bottom panel, an open low-height lilac arrangement drawer with R8 ink outline and hard black shadow. It extends UPWARD, doesn't open fullscreen or as a bottom-sheet modal, and doesn't move the five controls out of the familiar bottom area. The open 编排 button has lilac fill.
Drawer content:
- Small top labels "本编排" above fixed left region and "我的编排" above scrollable right region; tiny close × at far right, no extra big toolbar title.
- LEFT a fixed compact SQUARE tile around88×88vp, with title "本编排", smaller "4/4 · 3段", two style words "摇滚" and "爵士" plus "…" (never a third style), and check mark. This tile is the CURRENTLY SELECTED item, coral fill with white title and WHITE check; retained style labels may be small dark-on-light chips. This first tile is pinned, not part of horizontal scrolling, always available for switching back.
- Thin vertical black divider after first tile. RIGHT is a horizontal scrolling row of saved arrangement SQUARE tiles of same88vp size; pure white backgrounds, black names and text, innerR6, hard shadows. Show "夜行律动" with "4/4 · 4段" and "放克 嘻哈", then part/all of "起步摇滚" with "4/4 · 2段" and "摇滚", and a clipped edge of next tile at right if space. Show horizontal overflow by clipping, not by shrinking cards into tiny pills. There are NO 载入, delete or edit buttons inside this quick-switch drawer; tap a whole tile to switch.
- This is a compact one-row horizontal selector, never a tall vertical list and never still the old 12-style chip picker.
Keep the stage as large as possible, drawer around125–140vp high. Do not accidentally display a third style name in any summary or depict colored style choices as switch targets.
At the very bottom OUTSIDE app viewport include one restrained behavior line "本编排固定保留 · 我的编排左右横滑 · 点卡片切换", no extra diagrams. This is a design preview and does not claim seamless switching at musical boundary.

notes: Lobby image uses editor image for visual language and existing source-derived lobby controls. March image uses actual existing walking screenshot only for scene and control layout; recording-specific UI omitted because example is not recording.
